name: basic-data-analytics
title: Basic Data Analytics (Simple Batch)
description: Architecture blueprint for straightforward batch analytics: land data into a Warehouse (or Lakehouse), model it, and report on it — no medallion layering. Best for smaller/simpler analytics where a single storage tier and a report are enough.
best_for: Simple batch reporting scenarios that do not need layered refinement — get data in, model it, visualize it.

item_set.purpose: Load source data into the warehouse
Low-code Power Query ingestion/prep (alternative to Copy Job)

decisions.guidance: Warehouse for pure T-SQL/BI with write transactions; Lakehouse if you also need files/Spark or Direct Lake.
Copy Job for simple copies; Dataflow Gen2 for low-code transforms during load; Data Pipeline if you need orchestration.
Report for interactive dashboards; Paginated for pixel-perfect/print; Scorecard for KPI tracking.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Warehouse (Foundation) -> SemanticModel -> Report -> CopyJob/Dataflow; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Ingest source data (fabio copy-job create, or dataflow).
Build a semantic model and a report.
Optionally schedule the ingestion for recurring refresh.
